title: Contact Crenosoft | Book a Free AI Audit
desc: Contact Crenosoft to book a free 30-minute AI audit. Melbourne-managed AI agency working with businesses across Australia.
lead: Tell us what you’d like to automate and we’ll come to the call with two or three ideas already sketched for your business. No obligation, no pushy follow-up.
hero_cta: Go to the form
cta_p: Fill in the form and we’ll email you within one business day with times for your audit, by video or at your Melbourne office.
body:
What happens next

  1. We reply within one business day with times for a 30-minute call, by video or in person around Melbourne.
  2. On the call, we look at your busiest workflows and the tools you use, and identify the two or three opportunities with the best payback.
  3. Afterwards, you receive a short summary of what we found. If it makes sense to go further, we send a written blueprint with a fixed quote in AUD.

Other ways to reach us

  • Email: [contact email]
  • Phone: [+61 phone number]
  • Office: [street address], Melbourne VIC [postcode]

Have a quick question first? Open “Ask Crenosoft AI” in the corner of the page, or try the free AI readiness check.
